title: neanotis foetida
intro: Neanotis foetida, commonly known as Indian squill, is a plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Neanotis foetida are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help in reducing inflammation and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of Neanotis foetida include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
